create.name: Il Cerchio – Monasteri e Centri Zen (Enso-ji)
create.bio:
Il Cerchio is an Italian Soto Zen network that began in 1988, when Carlo Tetsugen Serra, after training in Japan at Toshoji in the line of Harada Daiun Sogaku, opened the Enso-ji temple in Milan. In 1996 he added Sanboji, the Temple of the Three Jewels, a mountain monastery near Berceto in the Apennines with a lay and monastic community. Today he serves as abbot and spiritual guide to six places of practice: the L20 metropolitan centre in Milan, Sanboji, and temples or groups in Cecina, Padua, Naples and Pesaro. Several Dharma teachers he has recognised lead the weekly sittings, and the network belongs to the Italian Buddhist Union, on whose board he sits.

Newcomers can start with beginners' courses in Milan, Padua and Pesaro, half-day zenkai in the city centres, or weekend stays at Sanboji that mix zazen, teachings, walks and work in the woods and fields. Intensive sesshin of three to seven days run at the monastery most months for people with some experience. The network also offers Buddhist weddings and funerals, volunteering and training for companies, and Serra co-founded the Dharma Academy, which runs a three-year Zen course. Its YouTube channel carries his teachings and live talks, short reflections and conversations with other Buddhist teachers.

courses.title: Ospitalità 14-15 Novembre 2026
courses.description: A weekend at the Sanboji mountain monastery near Berceto, open to beginners and experienced practitioners, with meditation, teachings, walks and work in the fields and woods.

courses.title: Zenkai Milano – Mattinata di meditazione domenica 22 novembre
courses.description: A Sunday morning of sitting and walking meditation at the L20 centre in Milan, with mindful tea and teachings from Dharma teachers Eryu and Tenryu. Some basic meditation experience is advised.

courses.title: Una Tazza di Zen – Milano – Domenica 22 Novembre 2026
courses.description: A monthly Sunday afternoon in Milan for getting to know and practising Zen, led by Dharma teachers Tenryu and Eryu. Booking is required.

courses.title: Mattinata di Meditazione e Insegnamenti Zen a Bologna con il Maestro Tetsugen Serra
courses.description: A Sunday morning at an aikido dojo in Bologna with Tetsugen Serra and Roberto Travaglini: an introduction to Zen and the zazen posture, walking meditation and readings, as a new local sitting group starts.

courses.title: Sesshin e Zenkai. I ritiri Zen
courses.description: Intensive sesshin of three to seven days held most months at Sanboji, suited to people with meditation experience, and monthly half-day zenkai in different Italian cities with sitting, walking meditation and a talk.

flags: Network listing: Il Cerchio runs six places under Tetsugen Serra (Milan L20, Sanboji/Berceto, Gyosho/Cecina, OraZen/Padua, Ten Shin/Naples, UnSui/Pesaro). Leads 1962 (OraZen), 1970 (Ten Shin) and 1978 (Gyosho) were skipped as sister temples covered here; owner may prefer separate listings, since each has its own site, email and YouTube channel.
Base: Milan, from the national secretariat address (Viale Liguria 20) on the contact page; the main monastery is Sanboji near Berceto (PR).
Lead name was 'Monastero Zen Enso-ji Il Cerchio'; the site and channel now present it as 'Il Cerchio, Monasteri e Centri Zen'. Name kept with (Enso-ji) for recognition.

Health rule: the site runs a 'Centro Trattamenti Zen Shiatsu' and a Zen Shiatsu school, with benefits including immune stimulation, fewer migraines and hormonal relief; all shiatsu left out. Sanboji stays also offer shiatsu treatments as an add-on (not mentioned).
Channel holds a 2026 interview with Lama Michel Rinpoche (NgalSo lineage, dropped by the owner on 11 Nov); not included.

Tetsugen Serra and his Dharma teachers (Myoen Raja, Tenryu Vesely, Eryu Grilli, Koren Montemurro and others) are not on Spiritpedia; teachers file empty. A web search found no allegations about Serra or Il Cerchio.
'MindfulZen' programme (described as combining cognitive psychology with Zen) not listed.
left_out: Zen Shiatsu treatments and Zen Shiatsu school: health claims.
Buddha Summer Camp 2025 guest talks and short interviews (guests, e.g. Vito Mancuso); shorts under ~2 minutes.
Theatre show 'Dieci icone del bue' (26 Nov, 1 Dec): a performance, not teaching.
Weddings, funerals, corporate training and the 5x1000 donation pages.
Dharma Academy three-year course: on a separate site, not read.
